text: The UEBA system flagged MJA2380's activity for the week of 2011-W02 due to evidence of unusual volume of attachment data sent to external recipients and overall activity volume far outside the same-role peer distribution. Specifically, the volume of email attachments sent was 60.10 MB, which is clearly above their usual range of 23.15 MB, and above the peer range of 8.63 MB. Additionally, the file operations count was 51, which is far above their usual range of 13 and the peer range of 1.
